race.title: Panoramic Restaurant At Limerick Races Mares Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: The refitting of a hood will surely help JUMBOS JET and in the hope she settles, is tentatively selected to find the improvement her mark requires on second handicap start. Galileo Springs , Kate Knows Best and Cathryns Ruby head the opposition. JUMBOS JET (IRE) GALILEO SPRINGS (IRE) KATE KNOWS BEST (IRE)
